title: Add market-aware scheduler and 30-minute premarket intelligence
target: StockTracker runtime scheduler and opening-session context
current: The trader scans the full intraday universe every 60 seconds even when the market is closed, producing repeated zero-bar warnings and unnecessary API traffic. It also lacks a structured premarket assessment.
proposed: Make the trader session-aware. When the market is closed, stop full one-minute scans and sleep until the next useful event. Wake 30 minutes before the next regular-session open and assess SPY, QQQ, XLF, FAS, FAZ premarket gaps/momentum, VIX, current geo/headline context, and social-source availability at 30/20/10/5/1 minutes before the open. Apply a bounded +/-5 premarket context adjustment during the first 60 regular-session minutes. Social sentiment remains explicitly UNAVAILABLE until a real source is configured. Use a 20-minute regular-session warmup before normal 1-minute scanning.
evidence: The user observed repeated 'Not enough bars ... 0' warnings every minute while the market was closed.
The current v1.7 run loop calls the full snapshot universe every 60 seconds even after market_is_open() is false.
The user explicitly requested waking 30 minutes before the market to assess headlines, social sentiment, and premarket movement.
risk: Moderate model-change risk because premarket bias can contribute up to +/-5 points during the first 60 minutes after the open. The scheduler itself reduces unnecessary closed-market API traffic. Social sentiment is not fabricated and carries no weight while unavailable.
status_note: User explicitly authorized the market-aware premarket release in ChatGPT with 'go'.
